basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of Pacific Heights, this sophisticated 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo offers the perfect blend of timeless charm and modern convenience. This light-filled home features an inviting living space and classic architectural details from soaring ceilings to custom built-ins, and a sweeping bay window in the front living room.   Modern amenities include an updated kitchen and built-in desk space for working from home. Enjoy 1-car garage parking and extra storage. A communal outdoor space provides a green retreat. With a walk Score of 96, this home is steps away from some of the city's most desireable shops and restaurants from Sacramento Street to Laurel Village and Fillmore Street.
